exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 1: CÂU ĐIỀU KIỆN LOẠI 1 (IF TYPE 1) - DẠNG 1: CHIA ĐỘNG TỪ TRONG NGOẶC (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Cho dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc để hoàn thành các câu điều kiện loại 1:

questions.prompt: 1. If it (rain) [blank] tomorrow, we will stay at home.
answers: rains
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn (it rains).

questions.prompt: 2. If she (study) [blank] harder, she will pass the entrance exam.
answers: studies
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn với ngôi she (studies).

questions.prompt: 3. If you (not / leave) [blank] now, you will be late for the flight.
answers: do not leave
don't leave
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Phủ định hiện tại đơn đi với you dùng don't leave.

questions.prompt: 4. If people (use) [blank] public transport more, air pollution will decrease.
answers: use
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Chủ ngữ people số nhiều đi với động từ nguyên mẫu (use).

questions.prompt: 5. If you mix red and white, you (get) [blank] pink.
answers: get
will get
questions.explanation: Chân lý/quy luật tự nhiên hoặc If loại 1: dùng get hoặc will get.

questions.prompt: 6. If you don't water these flowers, they (die) [blank] in a few days.
answers: will die
die
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề chính dùng will die.

questions.prompt: 7. If you (touch) [blank] that hot stove, you will burn your hand.
answers: touch
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn (touch).

questions.prompt: 8. We (cancel) [blank] the picnic if the weather is bad tomorrow.
answers: will cancel
can cancel
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề chính dùng will + V0 (will cancel).

questions.prompt: 9. If he (not / hurry) [blank], he will miss the last train.
answers: does not hurry
doesn't hurry
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Phủ định hiện tại đơn ngôi he dùng doesn't hurry.

questions.prompt: 10. You will get wet if you (not / bring) [blank] an umbrella.
answers: do not bring
don't bring
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia phủ định hiện tại đơn (don't bring).

exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 1: CÂU ĐIỀU KIỆN LOẠI 1 (IF TYPE 1) - DẠNG 2: TRẮC NGHIỆM CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chọn đáp án chính xác nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho câu điều kiện loại 1:

questions.prompt: 1. If you ________ hard, you will pass the upcoming exam.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính dùng will pass ➔ Mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn (study).

questions.prompt: 2. Unless you ________ quiet, the baby will wake up.
questions.explanation: Unless = If not nên mệnh đề sau unless dùng khẳng định (keep).

questions.prompt: 3. What will happen if we ________ taking care of the environment?
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề If chia hiện tại đơn phủ định (don't start).

questions.prompt: 4. You can't enter the room unless you ________ a password.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless ở hiện tại dùng thể khẳng định (have).

questions.prompt: 5. If I have free time this afternoon, I ________ you with your homework.
questions.explanation: If loại 1: Mệnh đề chính dùng will + V0 (will help).

questions.prompt: 6. If the sun ________, we will go for a walk in the park.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ the sun số ít đi với động từ thêm s (shines).

questions.prompt: 7. If you press this button, the machine ________ working.
questions.explanation: Sự thật hiển nhiên/vận hành máy móc: dùng hiện tại đơn (starts).

questions.prompt: 8. Unless he ________ hard, he won't get a promotion.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless dùng khẳng định ngôi he thêm s (works).

questions.prompt: 9. Unless it ________, we will play football in the yard.
questions.explanation: Sau Unless dùng khẳng định (rains).

questions.prompt: 10. If the flight arrives on time, we ________ our friends at 8 PM.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính If loại 1 dùng will meet.

exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 1: CÂU ĐIỀU KIỆN LOẠI 1 (IF TYPE 1) - DẠNG 3: VIẾT LẠI CÂU (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Viết lại các câu sau sang câu điều kiện loại 1 hoặc dùng Unless:

questions.prompt: 1. Hurry up or you will miss the morning train.
answers: hurry up, you will miss the morning train.
hurry up, you will miss the morning train
questions.explanation: If you don't hurry up, you will miss the morning train.

questions.prompt: 2. Practice speaking English every day, and your fluency will improve.
answers: practice speaking English every day, your fluency will improve.
practice speaking English every day, your fluency will improve
practise speaking English every day, your fluency will improve.
questions.explanation: If you practice speaking English every day, your fluency will improve.

questions.prompt: 3. If you don't water these plants, they will die.
answers: water these plants, they will die.
water these plants, they will die
questions.explanation: Unless = If ... not: Unless you water these plants, they will die.

questions.prompt: 4. If he doesn't hurry, he will miss the train.
answers: hurries, he will miss the train.
hurries, he will miss the train
questions.explanation: Bỏ doesn't, chia động từ thêm -es: Unless he hurries, he will miss the train.

questions.prompt: 5. I won't go to the party if she doesn't invite me.
answers: invites me, I won't go to the party.
invites me, I won't go to the party
invites me, I will not go to the party.
questions.explanation: Unless she invites me, I won't go to the party.

questions.prompt: 6. If you don't study hard, you won't pass the final test.
answers: study hard, you won't pass the final test.
study hard, you won't pass the final test
study hard, you will not pass the final test.
questions.explanation: Unless you study hard, you won't pass the final test.

questions.prompt: 7. If it doesn't stop raining, we can't go for a walk.
answers: stops raining, we can't go for a walk.
stops raining, we can't go for a walk
stops raining, we cannot go for a walk.
questions.explanation: Unless it stops raining, we can't go for a walk.

questions.prompt: 8. Keep silent or the teacher will get angry.
answers: keep silent, the teacher will get angry.
keep silent, the teacher will get angry
questions.explanation: If you don't keep silent, the teacher will get angry.

questions.prompt: 9. Don't eat so much fast food, or you will gain weight.
answers: eat so much fast food, you will gain weight.
eat so much fast food, you will gain weight
questions.explanation: If you eat so much fast food, you will gain weight.

questions.prompt: 10. Save your pocket money, and you can buy that bicycle.
answers: save your pocket money, you can buy that bicycle.
save your pocket money, you can buy that bicycle
save your pocket money, you will be able to buy that bicycle.
questions.explanation: If you save your pocket money, you can buy that bicycle.

exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 2: CÂU ĐIỀU KIỆN LOẠI 2 (IF TYPE 2) - DẠNG 1: CHIA ĐỘNG TỪ TRONG NGOẶC (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Cho dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc để hoàn thành các câu điều kiện loại 2:

questions.explanation: If loại 2: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (found).

questions.prompt: 4. If I had enough money right now, I (buy) [blank] a new laptop.
answers: would buy
could buy
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Trái ngược hiện tại (right now), mệnh đề chính dùng would buy.

questions.prompt: 5. If I (know) [blank] his phone number, I would call him to ask for help.
answers: knew
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Mệnh đề chính có would call ➔ Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (knew).

questions.prompt: 6. If she (speak) [blank] English fluently, she could get a better job now.
answers: spoke
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (spoke).

questions.prompt: 7. If they (not / live) [blank] so far away, we would visit them every weekend.
answers: did not live
didn't live
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Phủ định quá khứ đơn dùng didn't live.

questions.prompt: 8. If today were Sunday, we (go) [blank] camping in the forest.
answers: would go
could go
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Mệnh đề chính dùng would go.

questions.prompt: 9. If I had wings, I (fly) [blank] around the world.
answers: would fly
could fly
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Giả định không có thật ở hiện tại ➔ would fly.

questions.prompt: 10. She (buy) [blank] that luxury car if she were rich.
answers: would buy
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Mệnh đề chính dùng would buy.

exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 2: CÂU ĐIỀU KIỆN LOẠI 2 (IF TYPE 2) - DẠNG 2: TRẮC NGHIỆM CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chọn phương án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) cho câu điều kiện loại 2:

questions.prompt: 1. If I ________ enough money, I would buy a new car.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính dùng would buy (If 2) ➔ Mệnh đề If dùng had.

questions.prompt: 2. If I ________ you, I would tell the truth to the teacher.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc khuyên nhủ If 2: If I were you.

questions.prompt: 3. If I lived near the sea, I ________ swimming every morning.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If chia lived ➔ Mệnh đề chính chia would go.

questions.prompt: 4. What ________ you do if you won a million dollars today?
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ won ➔ Câu hỏi dùng What would you do.

questions.prompt: 5. If he ________ his address, we would send him a postcard.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính dùng would send ➔ Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn (gave).

questions.prompt: 6. If we ________ a car, we wouldn't have to take the crowded bus.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ đơn had.

questions.prompt: 7. If she studied harder, she ________ such low marks.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính If loại 2 dùng wouldn't get.

questions.prompt: 8. I could go out tonight if I ________ so much homework.
questions.explanation: If loại 2: Mệnh đề If chia quá khứ phủ định (didn't have).

questions.prompt: 9. If this room ________ bigger, we could put a larger desk in here.
questions.explanation: To-be ở If loại 2 chuẩn dùng were.

questions.prompt: 10. If they didn't live in the city center, they ________ cleaner air.
questions.explanation: Mệnh đề chính If loại 2 dùng would breathe.

exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 2: CÂU ĐIỀU KIỆN LOẠI 2 (IF TYPE 2) - DẠNG 3: VIẾT LẠI CÂU (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Dựa trên tình huống thực tế ở hiện tại, viết lại thành câu điều kiện loại 2 bắt đầu bằng 'If':

didn't breathe polluted air, we wouldn't suffer from lung diseases
did not breathe polluted air, we would not suffer from lung diseases.

questions.prompt: 8. I can't call her because I don't have her number.
answers: had her number, I could call her.
had her number, I could call her
had her number, I would be able to call her.

practiced enough, she could play the violin well
practised enough, she could play the violin well.
questions.explanation: If she practiced enough, she could play the violin well.

questions.prompt: 10. We don't have enough time, so we can't travel to Europe.
answers: had enough time, we could travel to Europe.
had enough time, we could travel to Europe
had enough time, we would be able to travel to Europe.
questions.explanation: If we had enough time, we could travel to Europe.

exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 3: CÂU ĐIỀU KIỆN LOẠI 3 (IF TYPE 3) - DẠNG 1: CHIA ĐỘNG TỪ TRONG NGOẶC (10 CÂU)

questions.explanation: Điều kiện hỗn hợp (If 3 sang If 2): nguyên nhân quá khứ (last night) ➔ kết quả hiện tại (right now: wouldn't be).

questions.prompt: 8. Unless he (apologize) [blank], I will never speak to him again.

questions.prompt: 9. If she had taken the medicine yesterday, she (feel) [blank] much better now.
answers: would feel
could feel
questions.explanation: Điều kiện hỗn hợp (If 3 sang If 2): yesterday ➔ now: would feel.

questions.prompt: 10. If I (be) [blank] you, I wouldn't lend him any more money.
answers: were
was
questions.explanation: Lời khuyên ở hiện tại (If 2): were.

exercise_groups.group_title: PHẦN 4: BÀI TẬP TỔNG HỢP (MIXED CONDITIONALS) - DẠNG 2: TRẮC NGHIỆM CHỌN ĐÁP ÁN ĐÚNG (10 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chọn phương án đúng nhất (A, B, C hoặc D) trong các bài tập xáo trộn nhiều loại câu điều kiện:

questions.prompt: 1. If the sun ________, we will go for a walk in the park.
questions.explanation: If loại 1: the sun shines.

questions.prompt: 2. If I were an astronaut, I ________ to Mars.
questions.explanation: If loại 2: would travel.

questions.prompt: 3. If he ________ so fast yesterday, he wouldn't have crashed into the tree.

questions.prompt: 4. You can't enter the room unless you ________ a valid password.
questions.explanation: Unless dùng khẳng định: unless you have.

questions.prompt: 5. If I had known you were coming, I ________ a bigger cake yesterday.

questions.prompt: 6. If she had studied for the quiz yesterday, she ________ happy right now.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện hỗn hợp (If 3 sang If 2): kết quả ở hiện tại (right now) dùng would be.

questions.prompt: 7. What will happen if we ________ taking care of the environment?
questions.explanation: If loại 1: don't start.

questions.prompt: 8. If we ________ a car right now, we wouldn't have to take the crowded bus.
questions.explanation: Trái ngược hiện tại (If 2): had.

questions.prompt: 9. If they had checked the engine carefully, the car ________ down on the highway.
questions.explanation: If loại 3: wouldn't have broken.

questions.prompt: 10. Unless it ________, we will play football in the yard this afternoon.
questions.explanation: Unless dùng khẳng định: rains.

had studied for the test, he would not have failed.

wear a warm coat, you will catch a cold

lived close to his gym, he would not always arrive late.
